entities.name: Kasimir
entities.description: Hermit of Kusho, once a kentsu general, who defends the island.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: Island on Dominaria where Kasimir lives.

entities.name: Gosta Dirk
entities.description: Powerful warrior and wizard who leads Kusho in crises.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Rival who beat Kasimir for the imperial champion position.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: Leading general of the kentsu who wounded Kasimir.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Emperor who sent the kentsu to conquer the Edemis.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Sent monsters and assassins against the Edemis.

entities.name: Lady Caleria
entities.description: Rallied the Edemi Islands against Madara.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Received Kasimir's message to leave Kusho.

entities.name: Tor Wauki
entities.description: Received Kasimir's message to leave Kusho.

entities.name: Empire of Madara
entities.description: Empire that fought the Edemi Islands.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War in which Lady Caleria rallied the Edemi Islands against Madara.

events.summary: Kasimir duels Tetsuo Umezawa for the imperial champion position, loses and chooses exile.
events.quote: Kasimir didn't want to live in disgrace and chose exile instead.

events.summary: On Kusho Kasimir allies with Gosta Dirk and guards the island in the Madara-Edemi War, fighting Tetsuo again.
events.quote: Kasimir acted as Kusho's guardian, even fighting Tetsuo again.

events.summary: Marhault Elsdragon beats Kasimir, blasting a hole through his torso; Kusho's waters and Ragnar save him.
events.quote: Elsdragon had blasted a hole through his torso

events.summary: Kasimir guards the ill Gosta and nearly kills himself fighting Halfdane.
events.quote: The hermit nearly killed himself fighting the shapeshifter

events.summary: Kasimir brings Ayesha Tanaka and Tor Wauki a message to leave Kusho after killing Halfdane.
events.quote: they should get off Kusho as soon as they had killed Halfdane

relations.quote: Kasimir allied himself with Gosta Dirk
Kasimir used to be a general in the kentsu
the leading general of the kentsu
